scope_exclusions.policy: Do not count upstream HEAD candidates until a governed adoption record exists; keep them in the HEAD/control ledger.

composite_findings.finding: The expected-value atom combines detecting/rejecting a tautology with replacing it from an independent oracle; those effects can fail separately.
Preserve compatible intent, surface trade-off, and avoid invented behavior are independently degradable.
Stage, commit, and rebase-continue are distinct state changes and authorization points.
Context-load and cognitive-load branches fail independently.
Leading-word selection, front-loading, invocation anchor, and execution anchor are collapsed.
Ordered steps, in-file reference, disclosed reference, and condition-bearing pointer are collapsed.
Six failure modes have independent triggers and cures.
Single-source ownership and obsolete-prose pruning are independent.
Fowler fallback and repository-rule override can fail independently.
Creating a deliberate violation and checking its exact failure are distinct.
Writing at a real seam and reporting no seam are mutually exclusive, independently testable branches.
Expand, migrate batches, contract, and fallback integration are separately failing stages.
Prefer existing/highest seam and minimize seam count are distinct decisions.
Loading prior records, concept matching, human confirmation, durable reason, and anti-poisoning are collapsed.
Creating lifecycle history and recording rationale are distinct.
One row covers multiple route targets and two harness catalogs, so one target can fail while the atom appears partially present.
Nested-reference closure is stated across all parents; each parent/reference/harness edge can fail independently.
Environment inspection, captured error text, and artifact persistence are separate secret sinks.
Four dependency classes and their isolation strategies are compressed into one atom.
Preserve compatible intent, choose merge goal, and disclose trade-off are collapsed.
Persistent workspace and mission grounding are independently failing.
Three information tiers are compressed.
Standards and Spec effects are named together; each axis needs its own output atom plus a coordination atom.
Expand, migrate, and contract are independent stages.
What changed and why are separate observable fields.
Claude link and Codex catalog can fail independently.
Environment-as-SSOT and cache-only-costly-facts are two effects.

reasons: The three atom sets are not semantically equal: 196 source, 109 live, and 135 independent.
At least one source atom, eighteen live atoms, and multiple independent atoms are composite under the stated atom rule.
Sixty-one adopted-source behaviors have no separate atom in either replay; presence inside an umbrella cannot close U-203.
Twenty-five live rows are local trigger/control-plane findings rather than adopted-source capability atoms, so a raw union changes scope.
Thirteen independent rows are local controls or an unadopted HEAD candidate, so majority vote or intersection would be unsound.

recommended_final_denominator_policy.name: SOURCE_FLOOR_PLUS_SEPARATE_CONTROL_LEDGER
recommended_final_denominator_policy.denominator_rule: Use every atomic adopted-source behavior as the non-negotiable floor; exact installs enumerate the whole installed contract and ports enumerate only the approved subset. Never delete an atom because live evidence is missing.
required_replay: Expand live and independent replays until every adopted source ID has an explicit one-to-one semantic row or an explicitly justified consumer-specific one-to-many mapping.

Move route, project-pin, adapter, activation, receipt, and hermeticity controls into a separately counted control ledger; controls gate the handshake but do not substitute for MATT-derived capability atoms.
Keep unadopted HEAD deltas outside the denominator until adoption-log governance admits them.
Re-run the third-way equality check; any unmatched atom, composite, or true collision remains exit-33/BLOCKED.
